# Retribution: best damage build, gear and stat weights

This file gives the best damage builds on one target for the beta trees and for the proposed trees. It also gives the pre-raid gear and the stat weights. All values come from wowsims Forever (see [README](README.md)).

| Trees | Case | Best build | Points | Code | DPS |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Proposed | Raid | Holy Shock build | 21/0/30 | `v5p50032032201010002--022553100133032` | 860 |
| Proposed | Raid | Ret build | 11/8/32 | `v5p5003003-030000000000005-0215531201330321` | 852 |
| Proposed | Fresh 60 | Ret build | 11/8/32 | `v5p5003003-030000000000005-0225531201330311` | 341 |
| Beta | Raid | Holy Shock build | 23/0/28 | `551030032001012--052152310012303` | 879 |
| Beta | Raid | Ret build | 15/0/36 | `55003002--05225331201330321` | 812 |
| Beta | Fresh 60 | Holy and Retribution build | 22/0/29 | `550031031101002--052251310013303` | 315 |

- **Raid.** "Raid" is full raid buffs and debuffs, with consumables. In the proposed trees, the Holy Shock build and the Ret build are equal (within 1%). In the beta, the Holy Shock build is 8% above the best Ret build.
- **Fresh 60.** "Fresh 60" is no buffs, no debuffs and no consumables. The proposed Ret build is the best: 8% above the best beta build. The Holy Shock builds go out of mana.
- **Proposed against beta.** In a raid, the best beta build is 2% above the best proposed build. The beta Holy Shock build has Divine Strength 5 and Consecrated Ground 2. In the proposed trees, Divine Strength is removed (Toughness and Divine Strength removal, C-P3), and Consecrated Ground (M-H4) is in row 6.
- DPS values: gear with no Fist of Cenarius (part 3).

## 1. Method

- **Sim.** wowsims Forever commit 47b3c01 (28 October 2026) with `models/wowsims/proposals.patch`. Proposals in the sim: Holy Strike Seal trigger (C1), Reverence (C-H1), Conviction (C-R1), Twist of Light (C-R2) and Sanctified Judgement (C-R3). Vindication has 5 ranks (Toughness and Divine Strength removal, C-P3).
- **Fight.** 3 min, one level 63 boss, 3,000 iterations. The standard deviation of the mean is about 1 DPS.
- **Rotations.** The default Twist of Light APL, and a Holy Shock APL (Holy Shock above 40% mana). Each result uses the better of the two.
- **Talent search.** A script makes valid builds with the rules of the calculator. It changes 1 to 5 points at a time and keeps a change when the DPS increases. The first search tested about 9,000 builds.
- **Path.** Gear search and talent search in turns, until neither changes. The gear search changes one slot at a time. It tests the 10 to 20 best pre-raid items for each slot. Then each build is tested with the gear of all the other cases, and the best gear stays.
- **Gear rules.** Item level 66 or lower, no raid drops, no raid materials, Alliance. Reputation and PvP reputation rewards stay in. The enchants are the enchants of the wowsims Twist of Light preset.
- **Codes.** The proposed codes of parts 2 and 3 load in calculator version 5 with 51 points (the version 5 page). Version 6 moves Retribution talents (M-R4, M-R5) and gives Vindication 3 ranks (C-P3). The version 6 builds are under "Calculator version 6" in part 2.

### Calculator version 6

In version 6, Burning Zeal has 5 ranks and Vengeance requires Burning Zeal 5/5 (M-R5), and Sanctified Judgement requires Improved Judgement 2/2 (M-R4). Vindication has 3 ranks with +2/4/6% Attack Power (C-P3). Thus, each proposed build takes Burning Zeal 5/5 and Vindication 3/3. A wowsims search chose the other points. The values use the Retribution preset gear, not the gear of part 3. Thus, compare only the change.

| Build | Code | Change | Raid | Fresh 60 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Holy Shock, 21/0/30 | `v6p50032032201010002--02252110013303205` | Sanctified Judgement 3 → 1, Vindication 5 → 2, Burning Zeal 5 | +1.2% | −8% |
| Ret, raid, 9/8/34 | `v6p5003001-030000000000005-020532120133032151` | Reverence 3 → 1, Holy Conduit 1 → 0, Vindication 5 → 3, Sanctified Judgement 3 → 2, Burning Zeal 5, Measure for Measure 1 | +3.0% | −7% |
| Ret, fresh 60, 9/8/34 | `v6p3003003-030000000000005-02253310013303215` | Divine Intellect 5 → 3, Vindication 5 → 3, Pursuit of Justice 2 → 0, Burning Zeal 5, Instrument of Law 2 | +4.1% | +2.0% |

- **Sanctified Judgement and fresh 60.** Alone, Sanctified Judgement 3/3 gives the mana for the fight. Thus, the Ret builds keep it. The Holy Shock build is a raid build, and it gives up 2 points of Sanctified Judgement.
- **Raid order.** With the preset gear, the Holy Shock build is 0.4% above the Ret build (854 against 851).
- **Divine Precision.** In version 6, Divine Precision is in its beta place (Holy row 5). The Holy Shock build has no Divine Precision. A build with it (28/0/23, `v6p50032032201212302--02251010013300005`) has 852.5 DPS in a raid, equal to the Holy Shock build. Alone, it has 249 DPS (Holy Shock build: 267).

## 4. Stat weights

Method: one stat at a time is added to the main gear (no Fist of Cenarius). Steps: +100 for primary stats and spell damage, +200 for attack power and armor penetration, ±20 rating, +10 weapon DPS. 10,000 iterations, the same random seed for all runs. EP = DPS for each point, divided by the DPS for each point of Strength.

| Stat | Proposed Ret, raid | Proposed Holy Shock, raid | Beta Holy Shock, raid | Beta Ret, raid | Proposed Ret, fresh 60 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DPS for each point of Strength | 0.416 | 0.417 | 0.448 | 0.443 | 0.203 |
| Strength | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| Agility | 0.81 | 0.74 | 0.69 | 0.74 | 0.73 |
| Intellect | 0.62 | 0.64 | 0.63 | 0.52 | 1.31 |
| Spirit | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.01 | 0.00 | 0.57 |
| Spell damage | 0.82 | 0.82 | 0.79 | 0.70 | 1.05 |
| Attack power | 0.45 | 0.45 | 0.41 | 0.41 | 0.50 |
| Hit rating, below the cap | 2.84 | 2.83 | 2.72 | 2.45 | 2.12 |
| Hit rating, above the cap | 0.27 | 0.64 | 0.65 | 0.34 | 0.26 |
| Critical hit rating | 1.11 | 1.07 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.11 |
| Haste rating | 0.37 | 0.90 | 1.60 | 0.81 | 0.04 |
| Expertise rating | 2.12 | 1.91 | 1.83 | 1.78 | 1.55 |
| Armor penetration | 0.11 | 0.10 | 0.09 | 0.10 | 0.04 |
| Weapon DPS | 6.14 | 6.18 | 5.79 | 5.72 | 6.86 |

- **Hit.** All five sets are at the hit cap. 10 hit rating gives 1% hit. Below the cap, hit is the best stat. Above the cap, it has little value.
- **Raid.** Hit rating below the cap, expertise rating and critical hit rating give more DPS than Strength. Strength is the best primary stat. Haste has more value for the Holy Shock builds than for the Ret builds.
- **Fresh 60.** Mana limits the DPS. Intellect (1.31) and spell damage (1.05) are above Strength, and Spirit has value (0.57).
- **Spell damage against Strength.** Strength gives attack power, and attack power adds to melee swings and Seal of Command at the full rate. Spell damage adds nothing to melee swings, and each spell takes only a part of it. With the proposed Ret raid build, +100 Strength gives +41.7 DPS and +100 spell damage gives +34.3 DPS.
- **Proposed against beta.** The weights are almost the same. Conviction (C-R1) adds critical hit chance to spells. Thus, spell damage and Intellect have a little more value for the proposed Ret build.

## 5. Limits

- The two APLs are the same for all builds. A rotation made for each build can change the result by a few DPS.
- The gear search changes one slot at a time. Thus, it can miss a set bonus that needs several slots at the same time.
- The sources in the item list are not complete. The item list can include some items that are not pre-raid in the game.
- Some proposals are not in the sim (moves only, Lingering Light, Reckoning). They do not change the DPS of one Paladin on one target.
- The fights are 3 min on one boss. Longer fights cost the Holy Shock builds more mana.
